entities.summary: Austrian Airlines Flight 901 was a flight from Vienna, Austria to Moscow, USSR via Warsaw, Poland. On the night of 26 September 1960, the aircraft operating the flight, a Vickers Viscount, crashed near Moscow while on its approach to land, killing 31 of the 37 passengers and crew on board.
